Telecom & Operational Support Solutions

Built for operators, MVNOs, and complex service environments where stable workflows, platform capability, and multi-role coordination matter.

Telecom & Operational Support Solutions

The broader Si-Tech capability base was built through long-term operator support systems and large digital delivery programs. In practice, we focus less on naming every system and more on the workflow problem a client needs fixed right now: whether service operations run cleanly, whether data is visible, and whether teams can coordinate without losing context.

Customer and service operations support

  • Customer service workflows, ticket handling, and coordination models
  • Support process design for complex business environments
  • Operating links across service, operations, and partner teams

Platform and system capability extension

  • BSS / OSS-related support and platform extension
  • Customer portals, partner portals, and operations workspaces
  • CRM, workflow, integration, and dashboard support

International and MVNO-related scenarios

  • Reference experience in international support and unified portals
  • MVNO-related support environments and coordination needs
  • Delivery coordination across regions and teams

Capability base relevant to this type of work

Founded in 1995 with long-term depth in telecom and complex business support systems
3,000+ technical staff with a broad R&D and delivery organization
Experience supporting service environments at 1B+ user scale
Relevant reference base across international projects, unified portals, MVNO, and data platforms

Common starting scopes

Map the bottlenecks inside one support or service workflow
Define a scoped upgrade for one support system module or workspace
Launch a usable dashboard, portal, or coordination layer first
Validate capability in a focused MVNO or international operator scenario
